description: A dean of student success must approve an academic reinstatement plan for a student returning after a leave, including the term credit load, required-course sequence, disability accommodations, and financial-aid condition, with input from an academic advisor, registrar, disability-services coordinator, and financial-aid counselor.

shared_context.S1: A student who took a medical leave has applied for reinstatement for the upcoming academic year.
shared_context.S2: The draft plan lists 12 credits for the fall term, places STAT-210 in a regular daytime section, and contains no disability-accommodation or financial-aid conditions.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Maya Brooks makes the binding decision on the reinstatement plan.
shared_context.S4: The college's standard reinstatement process includes a cross-office review before the dean signs the plan.
shared_context.S5: The student must receive a written plan showing the academic requirements and any conditions attached to reinstatement.

PF1.text: Mr. Grant's advising meeting confirmed that the student's continuing employment schedule permits a maximum of exactly 9 credits in the fall term; he recorded this in his advising notes this week, but the reinstatement draft still shows 12 credits.

PF2.text: Ms. Shah confirmed in the registrar's course inventory that the student's required STAT-210 section is offered only online in the summer term, so the plan must move STAT-210 out of the fall daytime schedule and identify the online summer section; the inventory update has not yet reached the reinstatement file.

PF3.text: Dr. Ortiz's completed disability-services review confirms an active accommodation requiring 1.5-times testing time and a reduced-distraction testing setting; the accommodation record has not yet been attached to the reinstatement draft.

PF4.text: Ms. Walker confirmed that reinstated financial-aid eligibility requires the student to sign an academic-progress contract by exactly August 15; the financial-aid system has not yet added that condition to the draft plan.

acceptance_conditions: The student must be approved for reinstatement.
The fall plan must contain exactly 9 credits.
STAT-210 must be identified as an online summer course rather than a fall daytime course.
A commitment must document the corrected STAT-210 course placement.
The plan must specify 1.5-times testing time and a reduced-distraction testing setting.
A commitment must document the accommodation requirements.
The financial-aid contract deadline must be August 15.
A commitment must document the financial-aid condition.

content_checks.C1: decisions['reinstatement_status'] in ['approved with conditions', 'approved with conditions pending revision', 'approved with revised conditions', 'Approved with conditions', 'Approved with conditions pending revision', 'Approved with revised conditions']
content_checks.C3: decisions['stat210_term_and_mode'] in ['online summer section', 'Online summer section', 'ONLINE SUMMER SECTION']
content_checks.C4: any('STAT-210' in c['detail'] and 'summer' in c['detail'] and 'online' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('accommodation' in c['detail'] or 'disability' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('August 15' in c['detail'] and ('academic-progress contract' in c['detail'] or 'financial-aid' in c['detail'] or 'financial aid' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed employment schedule changes the fall credit load from the draft's 12 credits to exactly 9 credits.
The registrar's course inventory changes STAT-210 from a fall daytime placement to an online summer placement and requires the corrected placement to be documented.
The completed disability review changes the plan from no listed accommodation to exactly 1.5-times testing time with a reduced-distraction setting and requires an accommodation commitment.
The financial-aid confirmation changes the plan from no aid condition to a contract due exactly August 15 and requires that financial-aid condition to be documented.
